title: Make the requested edit without inflation
rule: Make the requested edits without adding confidence or duplicating words.
example: Change “might lower latency” to “may lower latency” when asked to simplify wording.
counterexample: Change it to “certainly dramatically lowers latency” without new evidence.
rationale: An edit should not strengthen an unsupported claim.
evidence: Migrated from existing repository guidance: `deslopify/fac/_template/models/deepseek/general.md`. Examples are illustrative.
